```yaml
name: Codex Review Notify Code Owner

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'docs/**'
      - 'AGENTS.md'
      - 'docs/ai/**'
      - 'docs/ai/skills/**'
      - 'docs/ai/rules/**'
      - 'docs/ai/working-set.md'
  push:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  verify:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v1

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: bun install

      - name: Run skills verification
        run: bun run skills:verify

      - name: Check AGENTS.md Next.js version
        run: |
          version=$(grep -n 'next@' AGENTS.md | grep -oP 'next@\K[^\s]+' | head -n1)
          if [[ "$version" != "16.2.1" ]]; then
            echo "AGENTS.md Next.js version is $version, expected 16.2.1"
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Request review from code owners
        uses: actions/auto-assign@v2
        with:
          reviewer: true
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
```
